name: Endel
tagline: Personalized, real-time soundscapes that adapt to help you focus, relax, and sleep.
description: Endel generates personalized, adaptive soundscapes in real time, blending music and atmospheric elements with techniques like binaural beats and colored noise. Its patented Endel Pacific engine responds to inputs such as time of day, weather, location, circadian rhythm, and heart rate to create sound for focus, relaxation, sleep, and activity. The app spans a wide device ecosystem, from phones and Mac to Apple Watch, Apple TV, and in-car wellness systems.
insight: In 2019 it became the first algorithm to sign a music distribution deal with a major label, Warner Music Group.

modelSupport.notes: Patented generative-audio engine; no third-party LLM involved.

edge: Generates adaptive soundscapes in real time from your biometrics and environment, heart rate, weather, time of day, unlike static focus playlists.
cons: Not for making your own songs
